purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a Cinderhook Relay route-song disclosure crisis.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for Cinderhook's routine song work, the returned witness, four reporting methods, the Company disclosure demand, four disclosure acts, the third pulse, the folded closure state, the final choice, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use distinct visual_scene_id anchors for changes of focal area, character arrival, each material branch action, the one-sentence third-pulse turn, the post-closure state, the final threshold, and each ending family.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt describes a complete frame for a general image model: camera, route-hall geometry, light, materials, visible bodies, interfaces, and props. Character refs are assembled only for named characters or groups visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Painterly high-fantasy storybook illustration in a grounded Faerun register, moody ink-wash shadows, warm brass and amber fungus light, restrained blue-white rune glow, tactile living stone and worn rail machinery, expressive readable silhouettes, humane workplace detail, cinematic interactive-fiction composition, image-only signage rendered as simple symbols and marks.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every render prompt from the global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual_character_refs only for characters listed in visible_characters, and all triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Each base prompt remains complete enough to render independently. Continuity notes are excluded from model prompts.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture uses several angles and branch-persistent objects in one junction hall. The embedded draft map fixes zones, routes, occlusion, cameras, staging, signal state, and object state for review.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout of Cinderhook Relay and supply camera-specific renders to the image model.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a wedge-shaped underground junction hall carved from dark living stone. A brass-railed freight line enters through a pressure gate in the north wall, crosses the floor, and bends east behind a massive stone buttress. A low south arch is screened by knotted rope and turns out of sight. A bronze listening-well grate occupies the center. Copper, iron, and stone drip cups hang on the east wall. A dwarven dispatch desk with a red mechanical clapper stands against the west wall. Amber shelf fungi and blue-white rune lamps reveal damp stone, worn chalk marks, rail grease, and practical public infrastructure.
visual_continuity_notes: North pressure gate, east Glassvein bend, south Low Echo arch, west dispatch desk, central listening well, east drip cups, and the thick eastern buttress retain fixed positions.
The buttress blocks all direct sight from the relay into the returning train's approach; Low Echo's bend blocks all view of its forks and settlement.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide morning work scene in the wedge-shaped stone relay. Tikka Reed-Teeth, a short wiry olive-brown goblin in a patched rust-and-moss guide coat, tests a copper drip cup beside the central bronze grate. Orsa Feldspar, a square-built middle-aged dwarf in an indigo dispatch coat with a grey-brown braid and brass civic seal, writes at the west desk beside the red clapper. Veyr Copperstamp, a stocky dwarf surveyor in a fitted charcoal Company coat, clipped red-brown beard, silver measuring visor, and contract case, waits by the north rail. Warm fungus light catches damp cups; blue-white rune light traces the rail.

visible_characters.default_stance: standing at the central grate with copper cup raised
writing behind the west dispatch desk

visual_continuity_notes: Tikka can cross between the central well, south arch, and west desk without crossing the rail east of the warning stripe.
The red clapper and removable iron dispatch pin are reachable from the clerk side of the west desk and from beneath its low brass rail.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium action view toward the east side of the underground junction. He taps hanging iron and stone cups while Tikka, a wiry olive-brown goblin route-singer with black corded hair and brass listening cups, answers from the central grate. Orsa watches from the west dispatch desk; Veyr checks a brass watch near the north rail. Pale tunnel moths retreat from the blue-white rail glow.

seated at west desk with chalk lifted
standing by north rail with watch raised

visual_continuity_notes: Marn enters from the east approach on the relay side of the occluding buttress; the train remains out of sight.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Pivotal wide frame in a wedge-shaped underground rail junction at the instant of a magical pressure pulse. Tikka and Marn, two small goblin silhouettes, brace near the central grate and south arch; Orsa and Veyr, two dwarf silhouettes, turn toward the occluding eastern buttress. scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide crisis view of Cinderhook Relay. A compact rune locomotive noses around the thick eastern buttress trailing white steam; behind it, living stone folds into slow rib-like constrictions around the blue-white engine rune pattern. Heavy brass seals close the north pressure gate. Nine soot-marked dwarven mine workers in leather aprons, wool layers, helmets, gloves, and heavy boots jump down or cling to side steps. Two waist-high pallets of pale pump crystals are strapped to the engine. Tikka stands at the central grate, Marn guards the low south rope-screened arch, Orsa controls the west board, and Veyr stands near the cargo and north gate. Amber warning light fills the wedge-shaped hall.

visible_characters.default_stance: at south arch ready to guide
between crystal pallets and north gate

Orsa's public slate visibly pairs three pulse marks with an engine rune and one walking figure symbol.
The public board shows one blunt broken-rail symbol with every conditional field left blank.
Orsa looks toward the hidden depth of the south arch while Veyr studies her line of sight.
Veyr plants both boots between the pale crystal pallets and the north gate, contract case clutched against his chest.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Decision tableau in a wedge-shaped underground route hall after a rail closure. Living stone ribs pinch the blue-lit east rail behind a stopped steam locomotive, and heavy brass seals close the north pressure gate until its runes can be bled safe. Nine tired dwarven workers stand around the central bronze grate. Two pale crystal pallets remain strapped to the engine. The west dispatch desk offers public records and a delayed north rescue; the low south rope-screened arch offers the only immediate walking route. Tikka, a wiry olive-brown goblin singer, stands between the well and south arch. Marn guards the rope screen. Orsa holds a dark route slate at the west desk. Veyr guards the cargo. Amber fungus and warning lamps divide four visible priorities across the frame.

visible_characters.default_stance: between central well and south arch

state_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: Veyr's open book shows two pulse marks circled beside a separate observed third mark, making the contradiction visible as paired symbols.
Orsa's sealed slate is waxed shut against her coat while her gaze avoids the hidden south bend.
Loose pebbles fall from the south arch and the workers crowd closer to the route threshold.

Orsa returns the intact wax-sealed slate to Tikka; the route board shows only the public stair symbol while Veyr's chart remains blank below it.
